This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Spin-off Pokémon games|spin-off game]] [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Gates to Infinity]] for the [[Nintendo 3DS]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Chunsoft|Spike Chunsoft]]. All names are given in Western order and spelling is according to the Japanese game credits.
